note: Flaky test fix (no runtime behaviour change). vespera_macro reads the process environment through a single accessor; its unit tests override CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR / CARGO_PKG_* / VESPERA_* per test thread instead of calling std::env::set_var, which raced every concurrently running test (e.g. process_export_app_collect_metadata_error seeing an unset CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR). Orchestrator and openapi_io tests write their target/vespera sidecars into their own tempdir instead of the shared workspace target. The serial_test dev-dependency is dropped.
